// HANDS.md hand 27: Island, Sol Ring, Memory Lapse, and fillers.
//
// Eight cards rather than seven, because turn 2 on the play draws an eighth,
// and a second Island so that every deal gives the same answer: whichever card
// the opener is missing, turn 1 casts no Memory Lapse and turn 2 casts it.
2x Island [Land]
1x Sol Ring [Ramp]
1x Memory Lapse [Counter]
4x Opt [Filler]
